1.title: Anna Bella - Institutional Website
1.description: My very first project: a fictional institutional site to showcase a model’s portfolio. Built early in my career to practice HTML and CSS with multi-page navigation and a photo gallery.
highlights: First project early in my career
Simple image gallery with styled borders
Classic, elegant layout with plain CSS

2.title: TecBlog - Technology Blog
2.description: Hands-on project from the start of my career, built alongside parallel courses with my tech degree. TecBlog is a fictional tech blog using HTML and CSS to practice basic layout, typography, spacing, sticky header, and styling for links and posts.
highlights: Early-career project to practice HTML and CSS
Clean layout with sticky header and side areas
Sidebar with recent posts and categories

3.title: Simple Login Screen
3.description: A minimal, responsive login screen using only HTML and CSS to practice positioning and styling with gradients and transparency.
highlights: Fields with icons for email and password

4.title: Interactive Resume - Apresentation
4.description: Project from my first bootcamp with Codaí, where I first used Bootstrap. The goal was a personal site for job applications after the bootcamp—an interactive online resume with dynamic content switching and social links.

5.title: City News Portal
5.description: One of the first portals I built during my early web studies. I learned to structure multi-page HTML/CSS sites as a fictional news portal with categories and an image gallery.
highlights: Portal layout with columns and menus

6.title: Chalé Hotel - Institutional Website
6.description: Early HTML/CSS project from Jamilton Damasceno’s Udemy course. A fictional hotel institutional page with visuals, navigation, and a benefits list.

7.title: Parallax Effect with CSS
7.description: Practice project for a parallax effect using only HTML and CSS, exploring background-attachment: fixed for depth and smooth scrolling.

8.title: National Museum
8.description: Institutional-style site simulating a museum. HTML and CSS focused on structure, navigation, and embedding video, map, and form.
highlights: Institutional page with video and map

9.title: Finans
9.description: Modern, responsive landing page for a personal finance concept. Built with HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap to present features and benefits clearly.

10.title: Spotify Clone
10.description: Spotify-style landing page with HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap—responsive layout, highlight carousel, and promotional sections.

11.title: NPS API
11.description: RESTful API to submit and compute Net Promoter Score, with email integration and automated tests. Node.js, TypeORM, Nodemailer, and SQLite.

12.title: dev.finances
12.description: Personal finance tracker with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript—register and view income, expenses, and total balance.
highlights: New transaction modal with DOM interaction
Dynamic income, expense, and total views

13.title: Pomo - Pomodoro App with Gamification
13.description: Web app inspired by the Pomodoro technique, combining productivity with physical exercise and eye care. Breaks include challenges; users earn XP, level up, and unlock achievements.
highlights: Challenges for physical and eye exercises
Gamification with XP, levels, and achievements

14.title: UNES - University of Excellence
14.description: Modern, responsive institutional site for a fictional university. Evolves a legacy table-based site to HTML5 semantics, CSS Grid/Flexbox, and ES6+ JavaScript—with forms, smooth animations, SEO, and a full design system.
highlights: Full modernization of a legacy table-based site
Responsive layout with CSS Grid and Flexbox
SEO with meta tags and structured data
Design system with professional color and typography

15.title: desaba.fei - Modern Comment System
15.description: Modern, interactive comment system in React with responsive design and advanced features: live search, smart filters, editing, dynamic avatars, real-time validation, and local persistence. Gradient UI, smooth motion, and accessibility.
highlights: Live search by name, email, or content
Smart filters by date and name
Modern design system with rich gradients

16.title: MySkills - Developer Skills App
16.description: React Native app to register and browse developer skills—add skills, view lists, and login/welcome flow. Built to practice mobile development with React Native and Expo.

17.title: dtmoney - Personal Finance
17.description: Web app for personal finance from Rocketseat Ignite Chapter 1—track income and expenses by name and category with automatic total balance.
highlights: Automatic totals for in, out, and balance

18.title: ig.news - React News Platform
18.description: News platform about the React ecosystem with Next.js, TypeScript, and Stripe. GitHub auth, premium subscription, exclusive content, webhooks, API routes, and responsive UI.
highlights: API routes for checkout and webhooks

19.title: LalaMovie - Movie Reviews App
19.description: React Native app for movie reviews and comments—navigation, sliders, movie cards, comments, and ratings.
highlights: Top rated and lowest rated sections

20.title: GoFinances - Personal Finance
20.description: Personal finance app with React Native, Expo, and TypeScript—social auth, dashboard, transactions, categories, summary charts, and local storage.

21.title: SavePass - Password Manager
21.description: Mobile password manager from a Rocketseat bootcamp with React Native, Expo, and TypeScript—store service name, email, and password locally with AsyncStorage. Search and organized credentials.

22.title: Personal Portfolio - leorodriguesdev.github.io
22.description: First personal portfolio with HTML5, CSS3, and vanilla JavaScript—work, skills, and experience. Responsive UI, interactive experience timeline, project gallery, contact form, and animated background video.

23.title: EdimedApp - Medical Services
23.description: React Native and Expo app for medical services and scheduling. Beneficiaries book appointments, manage profiles, and track requests (EdimedPlus client).
highlights: User authentication with login and registration

24.title: AgendaPro - Online Scheduling
24.description: Full online scheduling system with Next.js, React, and TypeScript—clients book quickly while businesses control availability and white-label branding. Multi-tenant with dynamic company routes.
highlights: Full control of hours and availability

25.title: Mega Verifica - Mega Sena Ticket Checker
25.description: Web app to check Mega Sena tickets—pick 6–15 numbers from a 1–60 grid and compare against drawn numbers with a results modal.
highlights: Validation for min 6 and max 15 picks
Automatic match between picks and draw
API route to simulate draw results

26.title: Toninho Nickname Generator
26.description: Interactive web app that generates unique, fun nicknames inspired by “Toninho”—great for informal chats and social handles, each with a random image.

27.title: Personal Blog - leorodriguesdev
27.description: First personal blog with Next.js on React, React Native, Node.js, and Next.js. Posts load from a separate GitHub repo for independent content management—categories, code formatting, and comments.
highlights: Automatic article fetch from GitHub repo

28.title: dev.finances - Finance Tracker
28.description: Finance tracker with HTML, CSS, and vanilla JS—income, expenses, and balance with a modal for new transactions.
highlights: New transaction modal with DOM interaction
Dynamic income, expense, and total views

29.title: AgendAI - Smart Scheduling with AI
29.description: Full smart scheduling system with AI for businesses—Next.js 15 and React 19, auth, metrics dashboard, services and staff, hours, bookings, themes, and notifications. Firebase Auth and Firestore.
highlights: Unit tests with Jest and RTL

30.title: OnStart Tecnologia - Institutional Website
30.description: Institutional site for OnStart Tecnologia—technology that simplifies people’s lives. Four main pages: home, about (mission and values), services, and contact with location. Real client project.
highlights: Full institutional site with four main pages
Home with company and services overview
About page with mission, vision, and values

31.title: Coelho Tattoo 013 - Institutional Website
31.description: Modern, responsive site for tattoo artist Leonardo Coelho (custom lettering and calligraffiti, Porto Alegre, RS)—portfolio lightbox, WhatsApp contact forms, services, testimonials. Real client project.
highlights: Contact and booking forms via WhatsApp
Real-time validation with Brazilian phone mask

32.title: Eletel Sat - Institutional Website
32.description: Modern responsive site for Eletel Sat—30+ years of electronic security in Viamão, RS. Services include CCTV, alarms, gate motors, electric fences, intercoms, and solar energy. Real client project.
highlights: Modern responsive design with smooth motion
Contact form with React Hook Form and Zod
SEO with meta tags, structured data, and sitemap

33.title: STV - ELO
33.description: Mobile app for STV Group (Security, Technology, and Asset Protection)—internal communication with documents and useful information for employees. Real client project.
